summary: BidBlitz POS Customer & Merchant Experience Hardening - Iteration 314. Comprehensive testing of POS access, payment methods, duplicate payment guard, receipt totals, customer display, mobile/tablet layouts, and hardware diagnostics. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend testing verified all key features.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile cart button click intercepted by bottom navigation overlay on narrow widths

context_for_next_testing_agent: POS hardening features are working correctly. All payment methods show 'Noch nicht aktiviert' (Not yet activated) status as expected since they haven't been enabled in merchant setup. Customer display properly hides internal IDs. Mobile sticky bar has minor z-index issue with bottom nav but is functional. Receipt email action is MOCKED (shows toast instead of sending email). Tap to Pay remains unavailable unless certified provider connected.

merchant_pos_access.details: Merchant can log in and access /merchant/pos without being forced to setup when store/register exist. Setup warning banner shown as expected.

pos_home_essentials.details: POS home shows: branch chip, register chip, employee chip, connection status, search input, barcode input, categories, favourites/recent, product grid, cart panel, total, pay button

role_specific_layout.details: Owner overview shows: Umsatz Heute, Verkäufe Heute, Offene Auszahlungen, Niedriger Lagerbestand, Geräteprobleme, Offene Aufgaben. Quick actions: Kasse öffnen, Produkt hinzufügen, Mitarbeiter einladen, Bericht ansehen

payment_methods.details: 7 payment methods displayed with clear labels, descriptions, and disabled state ('Noch nicht aktiviert' badge). Methods: Bargeld, Karte/NFC, BidBlitz Wallet, QR-Code, Gutschein, Rechnung, Tap to Pay

payment_states.details: Payment state panel has aria-live='assertive' for accessibility. Ready state instruction shown: 'Bitte Zahlungsmittel auswählen'

customer_display.details: Customer display shows: merchant name, items list, subtotal, discount, tax, total. Theme toggle (Dark/Light/Kontrast). Receipt options (QR-Code, E-Mail, Drucken, Kein Beleg). No internal IDs exposed. Payment instruction has aria-live='assertive' and role='status'

mobile_layout.details: Mobile sticky checkout bar visible with total, pay button, cart button. Products in 2-column grid. Minor z-index issue with bottom nav intercepting cart button clicks

tablet_layout.details: Tablet shows catalogue/cart split visible. Cart panel accessible. Payment sheet displays correctly

help_tray_training.details: Training guide (Kurztraining) renders with 5 steps. Help tray accessible. Training can be completed without blocking checkout

hardware_diagnostics.details: Hardware page loads separately from checkout. Shows: Network status (Online), Printer status (3 verbunden), Scanner status (Kein Scanner gemeldet). Lists 3 printers with details

duplicate_payment_guard.details: Backend tests verify: pending payment with future expiry is active, expired pending payment is not active, non-pending status is not active

receipt_totals.details: Receipt HTML contains same total as transaction. Sales endpoint returns correct totals (total = subtotal - discount)

sales_page.details: Sales page shows 8 sales rows with receipt IDs, dates, payment methods, amounts. Back and Refresh buttons present

mocked_apis.receipt_email: MOCKED - shows toast instead of sending real email

accessibility_checks.touch_targets: Large touch targets on payment method buttons
